data.name: Daiying Slingshot
data.detailed_description:
Master the Art of the Slingshot

Daiying Slingshot is a physics-based slingshot action puzzle game where every shot matters. Use a visible trajectory to calculate the perfect angle, overcome obstacles, defeat monsters, and challenge powerful bosses across increasingly difficult stages.

Physics-Based Precision Gameplay

Every shot follows realistic parabolic physics. Adjust your angle and power carefully to hit enemies hiding behind walls, elevated platforms, and narrow openings. Skill, timing, and accuracy are the keys to victory.

Battle Monsters and Bosses

Encounter a variety of monster families, each with unique silhouettes and behaviors. As you progress, you'll face increasingly dangerous enemies and powerful boss battles that require strategy as well as precision.

Upgrade Your Feather Ammo

Collect drops from defeated enemies, open treasure chests, gather forging materials, and strengthen your arsenal.

Unlock and upgrade five unique Feather Ammo types, each offering different combat effects and tactical advantages.

Explore Challenging Stages

Every level introduces new obstacle layouts, height differences, and environmental puzzles that encourage creative aiming and precise shooting.

Features include:

  • Physics-based slingshot aiming with visible trajectory prediction

  • Puzzle stages built around obstacles, height differences, and narrow openings

  • Five Feather Ammo types with different combat effects

  • Distinct monster families and challenging boss encounters

  • Loot drops, treasure chests, forging materials, and progression upgrades

  • Desktop-friendly controls with mouse aiming and keyboard shortcuts

  • Full support for English and Simplified Chinese

Continue the Adventure

The journey is just beginning.

Future updates are planned to introduce additional monsters, stages, Feather Ammo types, gameplay modes, and new challenges to keep the adventure growing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 或 AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 或 NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 或 AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti 或 AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
